clusters.pick_reason: PR #1617 handles the legitimate use case: it adds an `isLikelyJsonSchema` early-return in the schema serialization path (line 146) and widens the `inputSchema` variable type to `ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema`, preserving backwards compatibility for the deprecated overload. PR #1596 only adds a throw in the annotations-parsing branch, which would break callers that pass a plain JSON Schema before #1617's fix can even be reached — making the two approaches mutually exclusive and #1617 the more complete resolution.
